title: Build a compiled .d3dbsp
summary: Compile the current map to a chosen .d3dbsp path.
outcome: A compiled BSP ready for preview or fastfile packaging.

sections.title: Compile geometry

steps.title: Choose output
steps.text: Choose Build → Build .d3dbsp and select a local filename ending in .d3dbsp.

steps.title: Read build progress
steps.text: The build window compiles a copy of the current map. Review its log and game-mode summary; if it identifies an object, choose Show in map to select and frame it.

steps.title: Preview the result
steps.text: After a successful build, choose Preview compiled map in the build window or Build → Preview last built .d3dbsp.

tips: This command uses the current document; Build .ff saves the map and packages more assets.
A .d3dbsp preview is an editor view of compiled data, not PS3 runtime rendering.
